verdicts.reason: A breaks the product badge apart: the cream circle sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, separate from the can. The can body is orange on orange, so it turns into an invisible ghost outline. The headline is also small and floats among scattered elements with no grid. B keeps the logo, headline, NEW pill and CTA intact with a clear hierarchy. However, everything is packed into the top half and the bottom ~45% is empty, the NEW pill and CTA float in a separate right column, and the product circle is crammed into the top-left corner.
